newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paris airports' postal traffic down 0.3pct in Q1.
newsitem.headline: Paris airports' postal traffic down 0.3pct in Q1.

text.p: Paris airports Charles de Gaulle (CDG) and Orly handled 34,012 tonnes of postal traffic in the first quarter of 1997, down 0.3 percent on the same period last year, Paris airport authority figures show.
The number of flights wholly dedicated to postal traffic totalled 2,110, an increase of 7.5 percent on January-March 1996, said Aeroports de Paris.
A total, 61.2 percent of global tonnage was transported by post-only flights, compared to 57 percent in the same 1996 period. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706; Fax:5017
